questions.question: What is the primary objective of a Quantum Feature Map?
options: To map classical data into quantum Hilbert space statevectors
To reduce the number of classical bits stored on disk
To compress audio signals using quantum Fourier transform
To convert qubit measurements into classical floating point numbers
questions.explanation: Quantum feature maps embed classical feature vectors x into multi-qubit statevectors |ψ(x)⟩ in a high-dimensional Hilbert space.

questions.question: In Angle Encoding, how are feature values x_i represented on a qubit?
options: As computational basis bit values |0⟩ or |1⟩
As rotation angles θ = f(x_i) in gates like Rx(θ) or Ry(θ)
As classical voltage levels in the control line
questions.explanation: Angle encoding uses continuous rotations (such as Rx(π x_i) or Ry(π x_i)) to encode continuous classical numbers into qubit phase/amplitude.
